title: Printable area sheet: parallelograms and trapezia (lesson 12)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 12 (Printable area sheet: parallelograms and trapezia (portal worksheet for this lesson))
intro: Lesson 12: Area of parallelograms and trapezia. To understand why the parallelogram and trapezium area formulae work and use them to find areas

model.title: A parallelogram has base 11 cm, perpendicular height 6 cm and slant side 7 cm. Find its area.
A trapezium has parallel sides 6 cm and 10 cm and height 4 cm. Find its area.

questions.q: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 12 cm and perpendicular height 4.5 cm.
A trapezium has parallel sides 3 m and 7 m and height 4 m. Find its area.
A parallelogram has area 72 cm² and base 9 cm. Find its height.

(a) parallelogram, base 15 cm, height 8 cm (b) trapezium, parallel sides 8 cm and 14 cm, height 5 cm (c) trapezium, 2.5 m and 4.5 m, height 3 m (d) a trapezium has area 60 cm², height 6 cm and one parallel side 8 cm: find the other parallel side
A field is a trapezium with parallel sides 120 m and 80 m, 50 m apart. Find its area in hectares (1 hectare = 10 000 m²).
Show that the trapezium formula gives the parallelogram formula when a = b.
A parallelogram has base 7 cm and height 4 cm. Its area is:
In ½(a + b)h, what are a and b?
Big question: how does cutting and rearranging help find an area?
questions.a: It turns a new shape into one we know (a rectangle or parallelogram) without changing the area.
